verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The GraphQL Developer API is only a developer building block, and the compliance-skills repo is an agent skills package rather than an MCP server, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
